propositions: The rebar codebase maintains two semantically equivalent headings (Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria) that should be consolidated into a single Acceptance Criteria vocabulary across detectors, routing, prompts, and documentation.

Success Criteria bullets under their own heading are not counted toward the P1 blocking floor by _count_ac_items and cannot carry operator attestation tags, creating a silent gap between author intent and verification logic.

The migration requires collapsing SC headings to AC checkboxes across 106 live store tickets, updating detector regexes and reviewer prompts to accept both headings transiently, then removing the SC alias after vocabulary migration.

Four permanent exclusions must survive the migration: plan_review_T2.md (pilot metrics wording), plan_review_verifier.md and _agentic.md (dod_uncertifiable), vendor bundle O-RAN-SC, and frozen test fixtures.
The completion.py:288 file retained SC vocabulary during initial scope assignment, requiring inclusion in the residual sweep to achieve AC1 compliance.
Post-implementation audits found zero remaining SC headings in the live codebase across 106 migrated tickets, with eight backticked prose mentions correctly preserved as non-heading references.
